d: Experience all goals and match highlights from Vietnam vs New Zealand in Group G of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. The two sides played out a thrilling 3-3 group stage draw at Aspire Zone in Doha with goals from Nguyễn Lực, Đại Nhân, and Duy Khang for Vietnam alongside strikes from John Woldegiorgis and Ethan Dyer for New Zealand.
